patterns.note: Major content sections are encapsulated within large, full-width rounded-corner 'cards' that stack vertically, creating distinct visual blocks on the page.
Headings use a very large, bold, and slightly condensed sans-serif font, often spanning multiple lines, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, legible body text.
A primary palette of deep purples and lavenders is used for backgrounds and accents, contrasted with a light grey background and dark text, giving a sophisticated yet vibrant feel.
A promotional banner slides down from the top below the sticky navigation bar after a slight scroll, and content sections appear to subtly fade or slide into view as they enter the viewport.
Product feature sections often use a grid of uniformly sized, subtly rounded cards with icons and short descriptions, maintaining a clean and organized presentation.

technique_notes: To rebuild the layout, use large, full-width containers with significant border-radius values, stacking them vertically with ample spacing. Apply gradient backgrounds to some of these containers for visual depth.

The motion system uses CSS keyframe animations to introduce elements. As the user scrolls, a sticky navigation bar remains at the top, and a promotional banner slides into view below it. Individual content sections or elements within them likely animate with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, triggered by scroll position.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, contrasted with clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Very rounded corners on large content blocks and buttons, giving a soft and approachable character; smaller elements have subtle rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical spacing between major content blocks and within the hero section, creating a sense of openness and clarity.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, rounded-corner content blocks, often with subtle gradient backgrounds, gives it a unique 'floating card' aesthetic that feels both modern and approachable. This consistent visual encapsulation of content makes the page feel cohesive and polished.
